atoms.evidence: The ban on factions was introduced in March 1921
the decree ordered the immediate dissolution of all organized groups and factions within the party that tended to weaken its unity
It effectively dismantled the Bolshevik tradition of open internal debate, platform voting, and free discussion before reaching a party decision.
Lenin argued that internal dissent and public criticism provided ammunition to foreign and counter-revolutionary enemies.
It authorized the Central Committee to use expulsion from the party as an extreme measure against any members, including its own, who engaged in factional activity.
It later provided Joseph Stalin with the institutional mechanism to purge rival political blocs
